item.title: Amazon adds SMS ordering to Alexa for Shopping
item.description:
Amazon adds SMS ordering to Alexa for Shopping

Amazon is expanding its Alexa for Shopping AI assistant with a new texting capability that lets users order items, get recommendations, and track deals via SMS.

📱 Overview

  • Users can text a new contact that appears in their phone as “Amazon Alexa” to shop.
  • The feature lets customers describe products or send a photo, and Alexa searches Amazon listings, texts back recommendations, and can place the order on the user’s behalf.
  • It builds on the Alexa for Shopping experience that launched in May, targeting moments when texting is more convenient than the app or website.

🧩 How it works

Request type Alexa’s response
Weekly groceries Orders groceries via text messages
Gift recommendations Provides product suggestions
Find similar product from a photo Searches Amazon listings and texts matching results
Track deals and prices Texts when a watched item goes on sale
Remember personal preferences Uses preferences (e.g., vegan options) for future recommendations

⚙️ Key details

  • The contact is saved as “Amazon Alexa” and can handle a wide range of shopping requests, including groceries, gifts, and photo‑based product searches.
  • Alexa says it remembers personal preferences over time and can track deals and prices.
  • The texting capability is rolling out to a small group of Amazon customers in the US starting today, who will receive a text invitation.
  • Amazon plans to expand the service to “millions more customers” in the coming weeks.
  • Quote from Rajiv Mehta, vice president of Conversational Shopping at Amazon: “Customers often jot down what they need the moment they think of it in their notes, in their messages, in their group chats.”

🚀 Availability

  • Initial rollout: small US group receiving invitation texts today.
  • Next phase: rollout to millions more customers in the coming weeks, according to Amazon’s announcement.

💡 Why it matters

  • Amazon joins other companies that let users text chatbots for commerce, such as OpenAI’s Dot and DoorDash’s Ask DoorDash AI chatbot.
  • The feature offers a text‑first shopping experience, letting users “jot down what they need” and have a personal shopping agent work “just a text away.”
  • By handling searching, comparing, and buying via SMS, Alexa aims to let users get on with their day without opening an app or website.

#Amazon #Alexa #ConversationalAI #Shopping #TextMessaging

Source: Amazon will let you text Alexa your shopping list

item.title: Apple expands Siri AI to act across all third‑party iOS apps
item.description:
Apple expands Siri AI to act across all third‑party iOS apps

Apple announced that Siri AI can now perform actions across third‑party apps as part of the iOS 27.3 update.

🔍 Overview

  • Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third‑party apps.
  • The change is part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday.
  • Developers can integrate Siri AI’s new features in “all apps,” allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user’s personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on‑screen awareness to complete requests.

🧩 How it works

  • Siri AI can use personal context, natural language prompts, and on‑screen awareness.
  • Users won’t have to mention an app’s name in their request while it’s in the foreground, during a Live Activity, or in a conversation with Siri AI about the app.

⚙️ Key details

  • A new “app skills” feature lets third‑party developers combine several tasks into a single action.
  • “For example, a person might request a ride with a ride share app, follow updates to the app’s Live Activity while they wait for their ride to arrive, then request to move the pickup location to a different address by saying ‘Hey Siri, change my ride pickup to a new address,’” Apple says.
  • Apple previously made a smaller set of features available to third‑party developers (as noted by 9to5Mac).

🚀 Availability

  • The update is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview and will be available with iOS 27.3.

📱 Expanded built‑in app support

Apple is bringing Siri AI’s expanded capabilities to its own apps as well, including:

App Siri AI Support
Calendar Expanded
Files Expanded
Finder Expanded
Journal Expanded
Mail Expanded
Maps Expanded
Messages Expanded
Music Expanded
Notes Expanded
Photos Expanded
Preview Expanded
Reminders Expanded
Safari Expanded
Shortcuts Expanded
Weather Expanded

💡 Why it matters

  • Users can ask Siri AI to find a coffee shop they visited last week.
  • Users can ask Siri AI to archive files that haven’t been opened in over a year.
  • Users can ask Siri AI what it can do in each app.

#Apple #SiriAI #iOS #ThirdPartyApps #AI

Source: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps

item.title: Google's Gemini AI to Automate Personal Phone Calls with 'Call for Me' Expansion
item.description:
Google’s Gemini AI to Automate Personal Phone Calls with ‘Call for Me’ Expansion

Google may be expanding its “Call for Me” AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family.

🔍 Overview

Android Authority reports a “Gemini Calling” introductory screen in an APK teardown. The screen shows example prompts such as:

Example Prompt Intended Action
Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late Deliver a quick voice message to a family member
Call John and ask if he is coming for dinner Deliver a quick voice message to a friend

These examples suggest the feature would allow users to dictate short, text‑message‑style calls.

🧩 How it Works

  • Users issue a spoken prompt to Gemini (e.g., “Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late”).
  • Gemini generates a brief spoken message based on the prompt.
  • The AI places a phone call and plays the generated message, reaching the recipient without the user having to speak.
  • Android Authority also found “granular permissions” for Gemini actions in individual apps, including phone‑call permissions, letting users control which apps can invoke the feature.

⚙️ Key Details

  • The rumored Android update would automate personal phone calls with Gemini AI.
  • Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late, or deliver other short updates.
  • Even with this expansion, Gemini would likely be limited to basic, text‑message‑like calls; it is not expected to conduct full, back‑and‑forth conversations.
  • Users could opt out of receiving incoming automated calls from Gemini via the granular permission settings.
  • Android Authority notes Google might choose not to publicly release the expansion or the permission controls.

🚀 Availability

  • The feature is currently rumored and has been observed in an APK teardown; no official release date or public announcement has been confirmed.

💡 Why it Matters

  • It offers a quick way to reach people who prefer phone calls, miss text messages, or still use landline phones.
  • The granular permission model could give users fine‑grained control over AI‑driven calling capabilities on Android devices.
  • If released, the feature would extend Google’s AI services from business contexts into everyday personal communication.

#Google #Gemini #AI #Android #CallForMe

Source: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
